regime_context: The detector shows a one-narrative regime in China A-shares: Banks lead with the only strong durability score (0.74), high breadth (0.833), crowding flag, and one of only two eligible themes. However, the backtest verifies that the absolute-trend gate did NOT help on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0, and rotation timing has no forward edge — so everything here is display-level attention/structure, not alpha. Given track_record dir_accuracy of only 0.373, I will lean low and keep leans minimal.
emerging_watch: Watching for a confirmed handoff from Banks toward Defense & Aerospace: Defense (rank 2, score 0.525) is the challenger with a narrowing margin of 0.128 and trend tag, but it is not eligible yet. I would retire this watch if Defense's durability_bar rises above 0.6 AND its score closes within 0.05 of Banks before year-end.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the dominant narrative and the only eligibility-true theme with durable trend health (durability_bar 0.74, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.833, rank 1). This is a leadership concentration read, not a return forecast: the trend gate did not help here, so I am NOT leaning on the validator edge. The one_narrative structure with 25% headline weight and 0.37 absorption suggests the tape is dominated by this theme, so it is a conditional 'stay with the leader' lean, heavily size-capped by the crowding flag.
theses.dissent: Gate_helps is false — on this mean-reverting tape, the durable-trend read has historically whipsawed and provided no drawdown protection; crowding_z 1.72 means the theme is extended and the rank-IC ~0 means the high score carries no reliable forward edge.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS turns negative over any rolling 20-day window by the check-by date while CSI 300 is flat or up

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: This theme is eligibility-true (rank 5, score 0.375) but shows mixed trend health (hurst_tag 'mixed', durability_bar 0.57) and is crowded (crowding_z 1.38). With no validated trend gate edge on this market and a weak rank-IC, eligibility alone is not a reason to lean positive. The avoid is a structural caution: mixed trend plus crowding plus a mean-reverting tape gives no directional conviction to hold.
theses.dissent: CXO could get a policy or order-flow catalyst that overrides the weak trend read, and the theme is at least eligible in a market where only 2 of 22 themes are eligible.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ closes up 8% or more before the check-by date while the CSI 300 is flat

theses.subject: Medical Devices & TCM
theses.thesis: This theme carries the highest crowding_z in the field (2.2) but is not eligible (rank 7, score 0.275), despite a high durability_bar 0.79 and trend tag. The high crowding plus non-eligibility is a structural caution: the strongest crowding read in a mean-reverting, gate-unhelpful market is a reason to lean away from being long this theme. NOT a fade call — a down-weight relative to the benchmark if already held.
evidence: crowding_z 2.2, crowded true — highest in market
theses.dissent: High durability_bar 0.79 and breadth 0.857 suggest real internal strength; crowding on a strong leader can persist longer than a sizing caution captures, and this is a display-only crowding flag with no basket-level drawdown edge.

falsifier.text: 512170.SS outperforms the CSI 300 by 10% before the check-by date
